name: root-decorated-class
note: 装饰器类单独成文件：root 目录在 `@` 起点没有候选、以前只能靠文件级 fallback 建对（Stage 4af-E 前）

name: root-two-decorators
note: 装饰器前缀可多个、同一行

name: root-decorator-call
note: 装饰器调用 `@dec()`：括号整单元，Decorator.Expression 是 CallExpression

name: root-decorated-abstract-class
note: 装饰器 + abstract 修饰词

name: root-decorated-export-default-class
note: 装饰器 + export default 修饰词链

name: after-ambient-function-void
source:
declare function gf(): void
@dec class C {}
note: Stage 4af-E 的主形态：声明壳在 `void` 后的换行处收口，`@dec class` 由 leftover replay 在 root 建出

name: after-ambient-function-newline-class
note: 装饰器与 `class` 分行的装饰器声明头（装饰器前缀允许跨行）

name: after-ambient-function-two-decorators
source:
declare function gf(): void
@a @b class C {}

name: after-ambient-function-decorated-interface
note: 装饰器 + interface（TS 的恢复形同样是 InterfaceDeclaration 带 Decorator）

name: after-ambient-generic-function
source:
declare function gf<T>(): T
@dec class C {}
note: 泛型 ambient 签名（返回类型以 `T` 收尾）后接装饰器类

name: after-export-function
source:
export function f(): void
@dec class C {}
note: `export function` 也是声明壳（无 declare，靠类型尾巴收口）

name: after-ambient-function-then-variable
note: 装饰器类后面还有一条语句：重放/收口不能吞掉后续单元

name: after-ambient-function-decorated-body
source:
declare function gf(): void
@dec class C { m() {} }
note: 类体里还有方法：装饰器类整条（含体）都由 root 建，不靠文件级 fallback
